text.en:
The percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted by
the MWSS as dividends to the National Government as provided for under

of Republic Ast No. 7656 is authorized to be adjusted to five percent
(5%), or an equivalent amount of not less than P57.06M for 2005.
Fond herdarm r 3.7983

Sec. 2. The adjusted dividend rate provided for under Section 1 is only
applicable on 2005 net earnings of the MWSS.
Sec. 3. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 15th
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Six.
December in the
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
